_doc: Engines the lab can lend the souls: real, runnable folders from the repo, mounted read-only at engines/<name>/ in every session of a run whose request names them ("engines": "cad,dataviz"). Each is copied once per run, proved by its health command before any model is called, and never harvested back. How to add one: ENGINES.md.

cad.what: The feature-tree CAD engine behind cad.mino.mobi: write a tree (JSON), build it exactly, measure named faces, check assemblies for interference and clearance, export STL/STEP for printing, draw SVG engineering drawings. Node 22, nothing else. Rendering to PNG needs a browser and is not available here.

dataviz.what: Statistics and charts with no dependencies: stats.js (estimators, intervals, tests) and charts.js (SVG-string charts). Run its known-answer selftest before trusting a new use of it.

models.what: Other models to think with, through the lab's proxy: the run's request names which (DeepSeek, Kimi, Claude Sonnet …) and a budget of calls. You hold no keys. Only works in a run that lends models (MINIPHIM_MODELS_URL is set).

arxiv.what: arXiv, the way the buildabot reads it: search, the newest submissions in a category, papers by id, as JSON lines. Uses the public API on the net; one command, one request (arXiv asks for ~3 s between calls). A door, not required reading.
